name: get_host_shell
description: Return the host shell executable, default working directory, and capability status.

name: run_host_shell
description: Run a host shell command and wait for completion or timeout. Each call uses a fresh noninteractive /bin/sh and the shared host filesystem. It has no terminal, live input, or persistent process session; processes left in its process group are stopped when the call ends. Text results include the command outcome, output previews, and paths to full logs. Successful image stdout is returned directly. Content limits can omit an image after the command has run.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or relative to the service startup directory. Omit to use the service startup directory.

timeout_ms.description: Command timeout in milliseconds. Omit for 600000 (10 minutes).

representation.description: Image data by default. Use url when the complete text output is an image URL.

expected.description: Content hint for stdout; omit for automatic detection. Does not apply to stderr.

name: browse_memory
description: Return metadata for a memory entry or list a room's immediate entries. Each record has address, name, kind, and size_bytes; memory contents are not read. Memory is persistent and shared across sessions.

address.description: Literal address of a memory entry or room, relative to the shared entrance. Omit to use the entrance, '.'.

entry_only.description: Return one metadata record for the addressed entry or room. Defaults to false, which lists a room's immediate entries.

recursive_size.description: Calculate sizes for returned rooms, including memories in all child rooms. Defaults to false; room size_bytes is then null for this call. Memory entry sizes are always reported.

name: inspect_memory_space
description: Inspect the space occupied by memories across all rooms and the capacity they share across sessions. Returns used bytes, capacity, remaining bytes, and used ratio. This reports current usage; another session can change it before a later write.

name: find_memory
description: Find memory entries and rooms by name within a room and its descendants.

query.description: The name or name pattern to find. Literal mode matches part of a name.

room.description: The room location, relative to the shared entrance. Omit to use the entrance, ".".

match_mode.description: Interpret query as literal text (default), a glob, or a regular expression.

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly. Omit to ignore case.

name: recall_memory
description: Search text in memory entries within a room and its descendants.

clue.description: The text or pattern to find in memory entries.

room.description: The room location, relative to the shared entrance. Omit to use the entrance, ".".

match_mode.description: Interpret clue as literal text (default) or a regular expression.

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly. Omit to ignore case.

name: read_memory
description: Read a memory entry and return its full text or image content. Unsupported content returns a diagnostic.

address.description: The memory entry location, relative to the shared entrance.

representation.description: Image data by default. Use url when the complete text output is an image URL.

expected.description: Content hint for the entry; omit for automatic detection.

name: remember
description: Write text or copy a host file into a memory entry.

address.description: The location for the memory entry, relative to the shared entrance.

path.description: Source file on the service host, absolute or relative to the service startup directory.

content.description: Source of the content to store.

mode.description: create (default) fails if the address already exists; append concatenates bytes without a separator; replace overwrites the entry. append and replace also create missing entries. create and append require an existing containing room; replace also creates missing parent rooms.

name: revise_memory
description: Replace matching text in a memory entry and report whether a match was found and whether the content changed.

address.description: The memory entry location, relative to the shared entrance.

old_text.description: The text to match, or a regular expression when match_mode is regex.

new_text.description: The replacement text. Regex mode expands captures such as ${1} and ${name}; literal mode keeps this text as supplied.

replace_all.description: Replace every match. Omit to replace only the first.

match_mode.description: Interpret old_text as literal text (default) or a regular expression. Literal matching is case-sensitive; a regex can set inline flags.

name: create_memory_room
description: Create a memory room and any missing parent rooms. An existing room is reused.

address.description: The new room location, relative to the shared entrance.

name: move_memory
description: Move or rename a memory entry or a room and its contents. An occupied target is reported as an error. References in memory content are not rewritten automatically.

address.description: The location of a memory entry or room, relative to the shared entrance.

destination.description: The new location, or an existing room to move into. Both are relative to the shared entrance.

name: forget_memory
description: Remove a memory entry or an empty room.

address.description: The location of a memory entry or room, relative to the shared entrance.

recursive.description: Remove all entries and child rooms at this location. Omit to remove only an entry or an empty room.
